data.animaCaption: Standing barefoot on the rain-spotted entryway floor in a borrowed pale-blue striped shirt buttoned crookedly and soaked nearly translucent, she clutches the damp hem defensively in scarlet embarrassment. Warm hallway bulb light glistens off her dripping hair against the cool blue glare of the storm outside the frosted glass.
data.promptProse: Captured from a close first-person vantage inside a cozy apartment entryway, Ayachi Nene has just ducked out of a summer downpour wearing your oversized pale-blue striped shirt buttoned slightly askew. Rainwater saturates her silver twin tails and makes the thin cotton cling and turn softly translucent over faint white lace beneath; standing barefoot beside a dripping umbrella on the dark wood floor, she hugs the shirt hem with one arm while trying to wring out a lock of hair, blushing furiously under the warm entryway bulb as cold blue storm light glows through the frosted door pane.
data.story: 突如其来的暴雨把两个人都淋透了。宁宁胡乱套上你递来的条纹衬衫，扣子还扣错了一颗，湿润的棉布贴在身上微微透出轮廓；见你拿毛巾折返，她赤脚踩在水渍上慌忙捂住衣襟——「先、先把毛巾丢过来！不许一直盯着看！」
